activity: Handle restaurant prep, the supplier delivery, and kitchen management. I check produce and storage, organize the prep list, taste sauces, and coordinate the kitchen while keeping my phone available for Mara.
Take a quiet break after prep, drink from the thermos, and check messages. I call home briefly rather than improvising if Mara sounds worse, then confirm the evening service plan with the manager.
Review the dinner mise en place and service notes, eat a small staff meal, and make sure the kitchen is ready before the doors open.
Work dinner service and closing duties. I cook through service, manage the pass, finish the closing checklist, and keep my phone accessible for any urgent message from Mara.
